tiers.name: Custom C++ Kernel on Legacy `Stream 0` (`NULL`) + Per-Layer `.item()` Scalar Checks
tiers.note: Launching a kernel on Legacy Stream 0 inserts an implicit barrier across ALL blocking streams, and .item() drains the entire GPU pipeline every layer!

tiers.note: Fixes C++ stream 0 serialization, but calling .item() or dynamic-shape nonzero() forces `cudaStreamSynchronize`, breaking CPU launch lookahead!

tiers.name: Non-Blocking Streams + Device-Side `torch.where` (Unbound Cross-Stream Free Without `recordStream`)
tiers.note: Restores 89.5% comm-compute overlap, but freeing comm buffers on the compute stream without `record_stream` risks silent memory reuse corruption.

tiers.name: `cudaStreamNonBlocking` + `getCurrentCUDAStream` + Device-Side Masking + `record_stream` + ` sync_debug_mode` CI Gate
tiers.note: Zero host-device syncs during forward/backward, 94.2% comm-compute overlap, 1.68x faster step (740 -> 440 ms), and 100% safe cross-stream memory lifetime!
